name: Classic Leather Jacket
description: Timeless brown leather jacket crafted from full-grain cowhide. Features a tailored fit, quilted lining, and YKK zippers. Ages beautifully with wear.

name: Minimalist Watch
description: Japanese quartz movement housed in a brushed stainless steel case. Sapphire crystal, genuine leather strap, and a clean dial with no logo — just the time.

name: Wool Blend Sweater
description: Mid-weight crewneck in a charcoal heathered wool-cashmere blend. Ribbed cuffs and hem, dropped shoulders for a relaxed fit. Perfect layering piece.

name: Canvas Tote Bag
description: Heavy-duty 18oz waxed canvas tote with vegetable-tanned leather handles. Internal zip pocket, reinforced bottom, and brass rivets at stress points.

name: Slim Denim Jeans
description: Japanese selvedge denim in a slim straight cut. Raw indigo, hidden rivets, chain-stitched hem. Expect 6+ months of break-in for a personal fade pattern.

name: Merino Crew Socks (3-Pack)
description: Set of three merino wool crew socks in black, charcoal, and navy. Reinforced heel and toe, terry cushion throughout. Temperature regulating and odor resistant.
